findings.description: PCB analysis did not include return path continuity data. Run the PCB analyzer with --full flag to enable GP-001 reference plane coverage checking.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PCB analysis with: python3 analyze_pcb.py <file> --full

findings.title: 4 ground domains detected
findings.description: Board has 4 separate ground domains: ?, ?, ?, ?. Multiple ground domains require careful single-point connection to avoid ground loops and EMI.
findings.recommendation: Verify ground domains connect at a single, intentional point (typically near the ADC for analog/digital split). Ensure no signal traces cross the domain boundary.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on PB2-P2
findings.description: PB2-P2 (PB2I-P2-2x18) has 1 ground pin(s) for 31 signal pins. Recommended: at least 8 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure PB2-P2 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on PB2-P1
findings.description: PB2-P1 (PB2I-P1-2x18) has 3 ground pin(s) for 25 signal pins. Recommended: at least 7 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure PB2-P1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J-ETH
findings.description: J-ETH (SM04B-GHS-TB) has 1 ground pin(s) for 4 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J-ETH has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Via stitching may be insufficient
findings.description: Board has 0 vias across 1925 mm² (no vias detected). For the highest frequency on this board (150 MHz), λ/20 stitching requires ≤48mm spacing.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias at ≤48mm intervals, especially at board edges and near connectors.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (55×35mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1299 MHz; (0,1) at 2042 MHz; (1,1) at 2420 MHz; (2,0) at 2599 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.title: ESD device TVS-CAN far from connector J-FAN
findings.description: TVS-CAN (esd_ic) is 21.0mm from J-FAN. Estimated pre-TVS trace inductance: ~15nH → ~551V overshoot during 8kV ESD strike (dI/dt = 37.5 GA/s). Recommended: <10mm.
findings.recommendation: Move TVS-CAN closer to J-FAN. The ESD current path from connector to TVS should be as short as possible.
findings.summary: ESD device TVS-CAN far from connector J-FAN

findings.title: ESD device TVS-RS485 far from connector J-FAN

findings.recommendation: Move TVS-RS485 closer to J-FAN. The ESD current path from connector to TVS should be as short as possible.

findings.title: U-1V8RF harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U-1V8RF (TPS62933DRLR) switching at 2.2 MHz has 27 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 14-40). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U-1V8RF. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.title: U-1V8RF harmonic envelope
findings.description: U-1V8RF (TPS62933DRLR) switching at 2.20 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 1.4 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 13th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.

findings.title: U-3V3 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U-3V3 (TPS62933DRLR) switching at 2.20 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 1.4 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 13th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.

findings.title: Large hot loop for U-1V8RF
findings.description: U-1V8RF (TPS62933DRLR) hot loop area ≈ 134mm² (triangle: C-IN2 → U-1V8RF → L-1V8RF). Recommended: <25mm² for low EMI.
findings.recommendation: Place C-IN2, U-1V8RF, and L-1V8RF in a tight triangle. Minimize trace length between them. Input cap should be adjacent to the IC with the inductor on the opposite side.

findings.title: Large hot loop for U-3V3
findings.description: U-3V3 (TPS62933DRLR) hot loop area ≈ 223mm² (triangle: C-IN2 → U-3V3 → L-3V3). Recommended: <25mm² for low EMI.
findings.recommendation: Place C-IN2, U-3V3, and L-3V3 in a tight triangle. Minimize trace length between them. Input cap should be adjacent to the IC with the inductor on the opposite side.
